## Shopify apps (12, official App Store names)

### PO Box Blocker — AddressFence
- App Store: https://apps.shopify.com/address-guard
- What it does: Free blocks PO Boxes and parcel lockers on the shipping address at checkout, plus a small set of ZIP rules. Street-number checks and billing-address rules are on a paid plan. Test any address in the simulator before publishing.
- Guide: https://apify.momiji-space.com/guides/block-po-box-billing-address/ — Shopify: Block PO Box on Billing Address, Not Just Shipping
- Guide: https://apify.momiji-space.com/guides/po-box-blocker-apps-billing-vs-shipping/ — Shopify app to block PO boxes: shipping is native, billing needs a checkout-validation app
- Guide: https://apify.momiji-space.com/guides/require-street-number-shopify-checkout/ — Require a street number at Shopify checkout after the Address Blocker sunset

### B2B PO Guard — Require PO
- App Store: https://apps.shopify.com/b2b-terms-guard
- What it does: Checks PO numbers (format, prefix, length, duplicates) on Shopify native B2B checkout and flags orders for review; D2C checkout is untouched.
- Guide: https://apify.momiji-space.com/guides/b2b-po-number-required/ — B2B checkout can skip a PO number unless a rule requires it
- Guide: https://apify.momiji-space.com/guides/b2b-po-rule-live-preview/ — Preview a Shopify B2B PO rule before you publish
- Guide: https://apify.momiji-space.com/guides/b2b-po-number-uniqueness-duplicate/ — Prevent duplicate PO numbers on Shopify B2B checkout

### Prop 65 Warning Manager
- App Store: https://apps.shopify.com/momiji-prop-65-warning-manager
- What it does: Shows California Prop 65 warnings on product pages after merchant approval and keeps an audit trail of picks, edits and go-live.
- Guide: https://apify.momiji-space.com/guides/prop-65-warning-examples/ — Prop 65 warning examples: 27 CCR 25602/25603 safe-harbor and short-form
- Guide: https://apify.momiji-space.com/guides/prop-65-audit-trail-picks-edits-go-live/ — Prop 65 audit trail of picks, edits, and go-live
- Guide: https://apify.momiji-space.com/guides/prop-65-california-only-warning/ — Show a Prop 65 warning only for California (US-CA) on Shopify

### Staff Access Audit Guard
- App Store: https://apps.shopify.com/momiji-access-audit
- What it does: Reviews installed app scopes, staff access records and ownership evidence without reading customer or order data.
- Guide: https://apify.momiji-space.com/guides/access-audit-app-scopes-customer-data/ — Audit Shopify app scopes for customer data access
- Guide: https://apify.momiji-space.com/guides/staff-collaborator-access-end-date/ — Set an end date on staff or collaborator access
- Guide: https://apify.momiji-space.com/guides/hide-b2b-companies-customer-service/ — Hide B2B Companies from customer service staff

### EUDR Records Manager

### Green Claims Guard

- What it does: Scans catalog and content for green marketing wording, flags it with the cited provision, and exports dated evidence records.
